newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL TO FACE CHELSEA IN F.A. CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LIVERPOOL TO FACE CHELSEA IN F.A. CUP.

text.p: Chelsea will play Liverpool in the fourth round of the English F.A. Cup while holders Manchester United could face a tricky home tie against Wimbledon.
The draw made on Sunday pitted Ruud Gullit's talented London side against last season's beaten F.A. Cup finalists Liverpool, currently top of the premier league.
The match will be played on the weekend of January 25-26 at Stamford Bridge, where Chelsea beat Liverpool 1-0 in the league on New Year's Day.
Liverpool's neighbours Everton play second division Bradford and Portsmouth entertain Reading in the only two other confirmed fourth-round ties.
After that the fourth round draw is a minefield of ifs and buts owing to the large number of third-round postponements this weekend.
Fourteen matches fell victim to the frost and snow and a further four matches were drawn and will have to be replayed.
Manchester United, seeking an unprecedented fourth consecutive F.A. Cup final appearance, will host 1988 Cup winners Wimbledon if the London side beat lowly Crewe in the third round.
United, who beat Tottenham in their third-round tie on Sunday, won 2-0 at Wimbledon in the first game of the season, but the Dons have lost only three premier league matches since then.

"Wimbledon should be favourites to play us because they are having a great season," United manager Alex Ferguson said. "(Manager) Joe Kinnear has really got them going and they are playing absolutely brilliantly at the moment."
Newcastle, who drew 1-1 with first division Charlton on Sunday, will face Nottingham Forest if they beat the Londoners in their reply at St James' Park.
And if minor-league Hednesford beat York in the third round, their reward will be a home tie against premier league Middlesbrough, 6-0 conquerers of Chester on Saturday.
Arsenal could face a fourth-round tie against Leeds, now managed by their former manager George Graham. The Gunners first face Sunderland in a third-round replay while Leeds take on Crystal Palace.
